cards.title: Today’s vocabulary
sections: taxi · /ˈtæksi/ · noun · Word · New
a car with a driver that you pay to take you somewhere. The taxi driver takes Mia to the station.
ride · /raɪd/ · verb · Word · New
To travel in or on a vehicle, or on a bicycle or animal. We ride in a taxi to the station.
downtown · /ˌdaʊnˈtaʊn/ · adverb · Word · New
In or toward the main business area of a town or city. We take a taxi downtown.
taxi stand · /ˈtæksi ˌstænd/ · noun phrase · Phrase · New
a place where taxis wait for passengers. There is a taxi stand outside the station.
drop me off · /drɑp mi ɔf/ · phrase · Phrase · New
Take me to a place and leave me there. Please drop me off at the station.

articulation.label: taxi
articulation.alt: taxi: /t/ → /æ/ → /k/ → /s/ → /i/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
/æ/: Low front tongue; open the jaw.
/k/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; release.
/s/: Make a narrow gap near the ridge; let air flow.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
